name: Ironhide
body:
Ironhide

School abjuration [earth]; Level druid 4, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M/DF (a piece of iron)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 10 minutes/level
Saving Throw Fortitude negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

The target’s skin gains an iron-like resilience. The spell grants a 50% chance that any critical hit or sneak attack that hits the target is negated and the damage for that attack is instead rolled normally.
